topics.label: Logic gates
topics.explainer:
Logic gates are the building blocks of every digital circuit — including the chips in your PC!
AND: output is 1 only if BOTH inputs are 1.
OR: output is 1 if EITHER input is 1.
XOR: output is 1 if the inputs are DIFFERENT.
NOT: flips its input (1 becomes 0, 0 becomes 1).
NAND: an AND followed by a NOT — output is 0 only if both inputs are 1.
A 2-input gate has 2² = 4 possible input combinations: 00, 01, 10, 11.

questions.q: An AND gate has inputs A=1 and B=0. What is its output?
questions.solution: AND is 1 only when BOTH inputs are 1. Here B=0, so the output is 0.

questions.q: An OR gate has inputs A=1 and B=0. What is its output?
questions.solution: OR is 1 when EITHER input is 1. A=1, so the output is 1.

questions.q: An XOR gate has inputs A=1 and B=1. What is its output?
questions.solution: XOR is 1 only when the inputs are DIFFERENT. Both are 1, so the output is 0.

questions.q: A NOT gate has input 1. What is its output?
A NAND gate has inputs A=1 and B=1. What is its output?
questions.solution: NAND is an AND followed by a NOT. AND gives 1, NOT flips it to 0.

questions.q: How many possible input combinations does a 2-input logic gate have?
questions.solution: Each input can be 0 or 1, so there are 2 × 2 = 4 combinations: 00, 01, 10, 11.
